item.text: {"summary":"The draft has a sound resolver and coherent final numbers, but it relies on U.S. and California history while omitting the directly available Colorado same-series history needed for the prior, update, and interval.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"base_rate","severity":"blocking","summary":"The stated persistence prior is the 2024 U.S. 65+ broadband share rather than Colorado's own prior value for the same Census ACS B28005 target.","actionRequested":"Fetch and state Colorado B28005_017E / B28005_014E for recent ACS 1-year years, at minimum 2024 and preferably 2021-2024, and use that as the main persistence/base-rate prior or explicitly justify why it is unusable."},{"rubricItem":"model_prior","severity":"blocking","summary":"The time-series prior is based on national annual changes, not the target state's same-series time path.","actionRequested":"Use Colorado's own same-series annual changes as the model prior if available; if still using the national series, state that it is only a supplemental benchmark and explain why it dominates Colorado history."},{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"warning","summary":"The +1.7 Colorado premium is qualitatively justified by income, poverty, and composition but is not anchored to observed Colorado B28005 levels.","actionRequested":"Quantify the Colorado-vs-U.S. gap in the latest available same-table year and use that to justify any movement from the prior."},{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The interval uses national annual-change RMS and then a small ad hoc widening for state ACS noise; this may understate or mischaracterize target-specific uncertainty.","actionRequested":"Base the interval on Colorado realized annual changes, ACS margin-of-error behavior for the state 65+ subgroup, or an explicit blend of national trend volatility plus state sampling uncertainty."},{"rubricItem":"prior_update_interval","severity":"blocking","summary":"The compact prior/update/interval step names a historical sample, adjustment, and sigma, but the sample is not the target history and the Colorado adjustment is not decomposed from observed Colorado data.","actionRequested":"Rewrite that step to name the Colorado historical sample, the starting Colorado prior, any national-trend or demographic adjustment components, the interval method, and the resulting bounds."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Keep the ledger resolution date while noting that the public 2025 ACS release calendar was not independently confirmed yet.","Add the latest Colorado ACS B28005 count pair to historicalContext so reviewers can audit the computed share directly.","Leave the no-catalog-circularity statement; it is useful and clear."]}
